name: Arteteca Pizzeria Napolitana

photo.caption: Unas de las pizzas de nuestra carta

description: Welcome to Artéteca, a Neapolitan pizzeria in the heart of Barcelona, just a stone's throw from the magnificent Sagrada Familia. With artisan dough and quality, fresh seasonal ingredients, every bite is a culinary journey through the authentic taste of the Italian tradition. Our passion for pizza is reflected in every creation, from the classic Margherita to the creative Carbonara to the Cheese, what a passion, our version of the five-cheese pizza. Come and discover the art of true Neapolitan pizza in a welcoming and authentic atmosphere. We are more than a pizzeria, we are a gastronomic experience to live and taste.

name: Monte Marinero
description: Welcome to Monte Marinero, Barcelona’s first Spanish-style seafood boil restaurant and bar! We’ve reimagined the traditional seafood boil by blending the best of Cajun flavors with Spanish seafood arroces (paella), combining Southern seafood traditions with local Mediterranean ingredients and modern takes on classic regional dishes. At Monte Marinero, we celebrate the rich flavors of Spanish seafood with a bold, Cajun-inspired twist. Pair your feast with local wines, craft cocktails, or a refreshing vermouth, and experience Barcelona’s most exciting new way to enjoy seafood. Come hungry, get messy, and taste the sea like never before!
address: Carrer de Balmes, 180 Sarrià-Sant Gervasi, 08006 Barcelona Spain

name: Faire Brunch & Drinks

photo.caption: We like to keep things FAIR

description: Eating brunch at Faire means having a positive impact on the planet. We carefully thrive to care for our earth, the by embracing sustainability, cooperation and care. We like to keep things FAIR. Serving an excellent brunch experience, with local specialty coffees and delicious homemade dishes, made with fresh and carefully selected local and organic products wherever possible. Our promise is that we will plant 1 tree per receipt. Yes, your delicious Benedict eggs will help reforest the world and support local communities!

name: Cremat Lounge
description: Cremat Lounge is the latest addition to the Cremat Group. Between 10am and 4pm it has the same delicious brunch dishes as Cremat 11 (known to have the best Pancakes in Barcelona). By evening time it offers tapas (a mix of local and fusion tapas with some vegan and vegetarian options, it also offer some gourmet burgers). Cremat Lounge also offer an extensive cocktail list with funky music and comfortable seating until 1 am. On Friday evening it has live music from 9pm till 11pm and on Saturday evening it has a DJ playing Lounge and house music from 10:30pm until 1:30am.
